input.text:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Operations Lead role. I have eight years of experience leading teams of guys on the warehouse floor and I report directly to the chairman.

I am a proven, world-class leader who always delivers. My synergistic approach leverages holistic best-of-breed processes to drive actionable learnings across the ecosystem.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how I could contribute.

Yours sincerely,
Jordan Lee
